description: Gaussian copula of the driver residuals by season and by season x 6-hour daypart (cells, used by sample.py). Produced by ridethrough/drivers/fit.py.

variable_definitions.temp_z: (temp_c - month-hour mean) / month-hour sd, from temp_by_month_hour.csv
variable_definitions.dew_z: (dewpoint_c - month-hour mean) / month-hour sd, from temp_by_month_hour.csv
variable_definitions.load_resid: load_index minus the chosen load model (load_model.json), load_index units
